silero.status: unknown; pretrained graph trainable-parameter inventory not audited

parameters.scope: Declared VCM/wake parameter counts and owner runtime_parameters; no ONNX initializer-size proxy. Owner training identity classifier is excluded from its runtime count.

sizes.scope: Runtime graph variants plus required model metadata/support; includes ONNX and ncnn copies. Silero graph is packaged once and loaded into two sessions. Excludes training checkpoints, Python/Node libraries, UI, licenses, archive compression and operating-system memory.

source_context.scope: Observed paths for this measurement only, not replay dependencies. Code hashes bind the executing module checkout; --root selects input/configuration files. Fresh execution resolves its current module root and explicitly configured .cache mount.

memory.scope: Whole current Python process including libraries, all five sessions, retained PCM and result storage; lifetime peak, not model-only RSS. Python worker IPC, Node, browser and OS costs excluded.

timing_scope: Actual serial CPU calls without sleeping. Complete budget sums one final VCM, every pre-final 8000-sample prefix, command VAD including computed silence tail, wake reference evidence, command evidence, all actual continuity passes, SpeakerSession arm/finish/application intersection, and active wake+VAD streaming. Wake startup warmup is measured separately. Nested frontend/window timings are not added twice.
interpretation: Preview max-cadence serial compute budget, not live concurrency or user latency. RTF divides compute by original paired command+wake duration; command endpoint silence and 512 alignment compute are included but add no credited speech duration. Warmup is 32000 zeros plus explicit final-frame alignment. First model calls are included. Synthetic command/wake pairs are chosen by fixed manifest order, not verified same-speaker ownership pairs; verdicts are diagnostic, not acoustic accuracy or authentication evidence.
input_policy: First eight distinct hash-bound own Qwen3 synthetic positive personal commands and first eight generated voice-test positive wakes; Apache-2.0 generation source receipt. No mixing/resampling/truncation.
